main.description: Gets the community's category layout, each category with its channels already nested. This is what a client needs to draw the sidebar in one call.

community.description: The community to list categories of.

categories.description: The community's categories, in display order.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks permission to view this community's categories.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.
